topics.title: Avocado inspections pause in Michoacan
topics.summary: The U.S. suspended avocado inspections in Mexico's Michoacan state after a reported threat, temporarily putting a key export route on hold while local officials add security.
topics.discussionPrompt: If your favorite ingredient suddenly got held up at the border, what would you substitute without admitting defeat?

topics.title: Wall Street drifts near records
topics.summary: U.S. stocks moved unevenly as corporate earnings rolled in, with the S&P 500 and Dow hovering near records while investors weighed company results and oil prices.
topics.discussionPrompt: When markets are calm but everyone sounds tense, do you trust the numbers or the nervous faces on TV?

topics.title: Sun gets its sharpest close-up
topics.summary: Scientists using a solar telescope in Maui captured the sun's surface in record detail, revealing rippling patterns that could improve understanding of solar storms.
topics.discussionPrompt: If you could safely stare at the sun's surface for ten seconds, what do you think would surprise you most?

topics.title: Electronic Arts goes private
topics.summary: Electronic Arts closed its $55 billion sale to Saudi Arabia's PIF, Silver Lake and Affinity Partners, ending public trading for the maker of The Sims and Battlefield.
topics.discussionPrompt: Would games get weirder or safer if big studios stopped worrying about quarterly public-market reactions?

topics.title: FIFA tries to steady leadership
topics.summary: FIFA said senior staff backed Gianni Infantino after a crisis meeting, while criticism continued over a failed plan to sell stakes in World Cup profits.
topics.discussionPrompt: When a sports boss says lessons were learned, what would make you believe the locker room actually agrees?
